name: Carbon Copy

dims.source: preset mxr_standard 60 x 111 x 32 mm bare enclosure (parts.js PRESETS, high confidence); verified_mxr_ehx.json MXR | Carbon Copy 1.25in (repeated dealer specs) corroborates height

knobs.note: REGEN left knob. Photo references/mxr-carbon-copy_hero.jpg top-down + front elevation; see references/mxr-carbon-copy_measurements.md.
MIX top-centre knob, behind the REGEN/DELAY row. Hero + back elevation.
DELAY right knob, same row as REGEN. Hero + front elevation.

led.note: Effect (bypass) LED below the MXR logo, blue on the real pedal, dark in the reference photos (pedal off). Hero starts ON; see mxr-carbon-copy.html.

footswitch.note: Round chrome stomp switch, centred. Hero + front/side elevations.

jacks.note: INPUT on right wall. Hero protrusion + right side view.
OUTPUT on left wall. Hero protrusion + left side view.

powerSide.note: 9V DC socket on the RIGHT wall forward of INPUT (references/mxr-carbon-copy_right.jpg). No back-wall power jack on this pedal. parts.js powerJack() is back-wall only, so spec.powerJack stays null and mxr-carbon-copy.html builds this socket from powerSide. Provisional +-0.1in (single clear view).

modSwitch.note: MOD push-switch, translucent pale cap at back-left of deck (hero + left side). Built by mxr-carbon-copy.html; no parts.js builder yet.

modLed.note: Small MOD indicator LED just forward-right of the MOD cap (hero, single clear view, provisional +-0.06in). Built by mxr-carbon-copy.html.

labels.note: White MOD print left of the MOD cap.
White MIX print below the MIX knob, between REGEN and DELAY.
White REGEN print below the REGEN knob.
White DELAY print below the DELAY knob.
Boxed MXR logo centred. Vector bold text; the rounded-rect border is drawn by mxr-carbon-copy.html (no shared builder change).
Vertical OUTPUT print on top edge by left jack.
Vertical INPUT print on top edge by right jack.
Smaller lowercase line under carbon copy.

notes: MXR Carbon Copy (M169) hero. Bare-enclosure dims from parts.js PRESETS.mxr_standard (60x111x32mm, high), corroborated by verified_mxr_ehx.json. Dark metallic green box, 3x mxr Davies knobs (REGEN/MIX/DELAY), MOD push-switch + MOD LED at back-left, effect LED + round footswitch. Coordinates: back=-z (knob side), front=+z (carbon copy text). All deck parts seat via surfaceAt() (flat deck h=1.26) - no hardcoded y on knobs/LED/switch. Side 9V socket and MOD hardware have no parts.js builder; they are spec'd here (powerSide/modSwitch/modLed) and built by mxr-carbon-copy.html. White print is vector textLabels (decal null, so validate CHECK B is skipped per PROCESS.md).
